findings.text: D1: Snowtrace direct fetch blocked (permission denied); contract addresses recovered instead from official docs page. GitHub org `Avant-Protocol` surfaced via search with repo `avUSD-Contracts`.

D2: Official deployed-contracts page found at https://docs.avantprotocol.com/security/contract-addresses.md — lists 30+ named addresses across Avalanche, Ethereum, Linea, BNB Chain, Berachain, Plasma, Katana, Monad, MegaETH, SEI, and Movement. Set as deployed_contracts_doc.

D3: Audit page at https://docs.avantprotocol.com/security/contract-and-opsec-audits.md lists 4 public audits: Omniscia (July 2024, avUSD system), Dedaub (June 2024, smart contract assessment), Omniscia (April 2025, cross-chain ERC20 bridge), Cyfrin (August 2025, Avant Max). No critical or high-severity issues reported. Trail of Bits is engaged for ongoing OPSEC audits (not public). All are from the same page — no scope-level addresses extracted.

D4: GitHub org https://github.com/Avant-Protocol has repo `avUSD-Contracts` (and 6 others). No deployment artifact files (broadcast/deployments JSON) could be fetched in this run — commit SHA not pinned. Addresses in admin_addresses sourced from official docs, not GitHub artifacts.

D5: Protocol.chains = Avalanche (primary chain for minting/staking). Docs confirm Ethereum, Linea, BNB Chain, Berachain, Plasma, Katana, Monad, MegaETH, SEI, and Movement as bridged chains. Separate admin_addresses entries created for each chain where avUSD-family contracts are listed. Avalanche is the canonical chain per protocol context.

D6: No factory contract pattern identified. Minting is via named AvantMintingV2 contracts (one per asset class). No pool-enumeration views applicable. MAX asset Requests Manager contracts perform whitelist and redemption logic — not factories.

D7: Role taxonomy applied: token (avUSD, savUSD, avBTC, savBTC, avETH, savETH, avUSDx, avBTCx, avETHx), other (AvantMintingV2, CCIP pools, OFT Adapters, Cooldown Silos), admin (Requests Manager, Providers Whitelist, Price Storage). actor_class set to unknown for all — bytecode/ownership not read in this run.
D8: All 30 addresses in admin_addresses trace to the fetched docs URL https://docs.avantprotocol.com/security/contract-addresses.md. No address sourced from memory alone.

rationale.verdict: Walked official docs (contract-addresses page), audit page, app website, and GitHub org search. 30 named contract addresses catalogued from the canonical docs page across 10+ chains; Avalanche-native contracts (avUSD, avBTC, AvantMintingV2, savUSD/savBTC staking, MAX suite) constitute the primary set. On-chain reads for ownership/upgradeability not performed — deferred to evaluation slices. GitHub repo found but no deployment artifacts fetched. grade=unknown because no on-chain state was read and no owner/admin addresses were confirmed on-chain.

protocol_metadata.about: Avant Protocol is a DeFi yield protocol originally launched on Avalanche's C-Chain that allows users to mint stable-value tokens (avUSD, avBTC, avETH) by depositing corresponding collateral assets (USDC, BTC.b, ETH) on a 1:1 basis. Users can stake these base tokens into senior-tranche yield-bearing equivalents (savUSD, savBTC, savETH) that earn yield from delta-neutral trading strategies including basis and funding trades, liquidity provisioning, and yield-token strategies managed by external asset managers. A junior tranche (avUSDx, avBTCx, avETHx) absorbs losses first and receives amplified yield. Assets are bridgeable cross-chain via Chainlink CCIP and LayerZero.
